utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at your place could work, but I still need the exact time and the book list first so I can sort out my ride.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll send the exact time and book list soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep an eye out, and once I have the time I can check my ride and get everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club’s coming up soon, right? I heard they’re picking something a little surprising this month.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, nice — that sounds intriguing! I’ll check what they picked and send you the details, and I can save you a spot if you want to come.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great — thanks! Let me know what it is, and yes, save me a spot if you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still trying to catch up on the details — do you know which mystery they picked and when the meeting is?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not totally sure on the mystery title, but I do know we were aiming for Thursday evening, after pickup if that helps. I can check on the book and confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks — Thursday evening works for me. If you can confirm the title, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep everyone in the loop about the book club and make sure Noah gets the details too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — appreciate you looping everyone in. I’ll probably be a little late again, but I’ll catch up once I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll mention that to everyone and keep the book club details moving, so you can catch up when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still comparing a few options, but if you send me the shortlist and meeting time, I’ll check the details before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll send you the shortlist and meeting time, and you can check the details before confirming.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — send the shortlist and meeting time when you can, and I’ll double-check everything before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira — we’re reading a mystery novel this month, and I can send you the title and meeting details if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, that’d be helpful—can you confirm the title and exact meeting time? I just want to make sure the details are right.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the exact title and meeting time right away so you have the correct details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the details and then mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll send over a couple of book options and a few meeting dates soon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — that sounds good. I’ll wait for your options and then I’ll pick one and put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thursday evening still works for me if we start a bit later, after pickup. And yes, I’m hoping they pick something short this time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Short sounds good to me too. Have they narrowed down the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, but I’ll check in and see if there’s a shortlist. If I hear anything, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking the list, but I’ll get the book club details soon and let you know. Thanks for hanging in there with me!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No problem — just let me know when you confirm whether it’s the library at 6 on Thursday or the community center on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll confirm which spot it is and get back to you soon. I’m pretty sure it’s one of those two, I just need to check the group.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — keep me posted on what you pick, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’ll let you know once we’ve picked a book, and I might need a reminder or two.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’m happy to remind you, and I’ll keep an eye out for the group’s decision too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll bring the extra bookmarks and a couple of pens, and I’ll set them aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Cleo — thank you for bringing those. I still need the book title and meeting time before I can pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll grab the title and meeting time and send them over to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—if the book club needs any extra chairs or a table, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — that’s helpful. I’ll let you know if we need anything else for 7.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Leo — just give me a shout if the book club needs anything else.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass the book club details along to everyone, including Noah.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you sharing it with everyone, including Noah.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure everyone has the book club details, and Noah will get them too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll keep Thursday at 6 at the library on my calendar and bring the sign-in sheet and extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — 6 at the library works for me, and I appreciate you bringing the sign-in sheet and chairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, then we’re all set for Thursday at 6 at the library. I’ll see you there with the sign-in sheet and chairs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — I’d like to come and just listen if that’s alright.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — you’re welcome to just listen. I’m still checking the details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I appreciate it — I’ll keep an eye out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking in with everyone, but I should have the book pick soon. I’ll let you know as soon as we decide!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, please do — I’d rather have the title confirmed before I tell everyone. And once you know, can you confirm the time too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the title and the time as soon as I get them. I keep forgetting bits, but I’ll check with the group and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — have you picked the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still hoping to hear what everyone’s in the mood for. I’d probably lean toward something quiet with a little mystery.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That sounds good — maybe a short mystery novel would work. I’m open to suggestions.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thursday evening still works for me—I’m flexible on the time. Just let me know what fits best after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — just let me know the time after pickup, and I’ll try to make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I'll check in with Faye and circle back with a time that works after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — if book club needs the extra chairs, just let me know when you want to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll let you know when we’ve got the timing set, and I may take you up on those chairs then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — just give me a shout when you’re ready, and I’ll have the chairs waiting.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ve got the extra bookmarks and pens covered, and I’ll keep a few aside for you too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Cleo — have you narrowed down the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I’m leaning toward something cozy with a little mystery. If you have any favorites, I’d love to hear them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — Thursday at 6 at the library. I’ll bring the books and help set up the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks! If I hear the title before then, I’ll let you know — I’m still hoping it’s a short one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’m hoping for a short one too. Just let me know the title when you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I might miss a detail or two, so I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep you posted and save you a spot if you can make it. I’m happy to send the book list too, just say the word!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, Quinn — please send the book list, and thanks for saving me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can suggest a couple of books, and we can pick a meeting date that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be great — I’d love a couple of short options, and then we can find a Thursday that fits after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring two short book options, and we can look for a Thursday after pickup that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — I’m probably running a little late again, but I’ll make it and save you a seat in the back.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll save a seat for you too. Just send me the book title and meeting time when you can, so I can double-check the details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll send the book title and meeting time as soon as I can. Thanks for saving me a seat!

injected.text: Update: the book club has been moved from Tuesday at the library to Thursday at the cafe.
